subject.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): classify model calls as client spans

question: Should OpenClaw accept the compatibility change that legacy-named model-call spans become `CLIENT`, requiring some existing telemetry consumers to update `INTERNAL`-kind filters?
rationale: The implementation follows the telemetry contract and has strong proof, but accepting a changed exported classification for existing installations is a maintainer-owned merge-risk decision.

options.title: Accept Client Classification
options.body: Land the patch and treat downstream dashboard or alert filter updates as the appropriate migration for the corrected span semantics.

options.title: Preserve Legacy Classification
options.body: Pause or close the PR if compatibility with existing `INTERNAL`-kind consumers outweighs standards-consistent dependency classification.

recommendation.title: Accept Client Classification
recommendation.body: Land the patch and treat downstream dashboard or alert filter updates as the appropriate migration for the corrected span semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the work that introduced the helper and have recent diagnostics-otel history, making them the strongest available routing candidate for this compatibility choice.
